version.changelog: Full coverage pass: deeper guides, situation-named files, and per-user configuration

llm.summary: This is a plain-text CEO advisory skill with disclosed human sign-off for consequential business decisions and no executable behavior.

dimensions.detail: The requested environment access is proportionate because the skill claims no external API calls, no network requests, and no access to files outside its auxiliary documents, matching the inspected markdown-only artifact.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The artifact consists of markdown guidance and metadata only; there are no executable scripts, install hooks, package actions, or automatic installation of related skills.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions are scoped to strategic guidance, templates, decision frameworks, and loading auxiliary markdown files; the skill explicitly says human sign-off is required for major pivots, executive terminations, fundraising terms, M&A, crisis public communications, and board seat changes.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential access, background workers, privilege escalation, or local data indexing behavior was found; the skill states no persistent storage is required.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill advises on high-impact company topics such as fundraising, layoffs, executive exits, pivots, board matters, and crisis communications, but those topics are the stated purpose of a CEO advisory skill and are disclosed throughout the artifact.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Use this as advisory material for sensitive business decisions, not as an autonomous decision-maker. Review outputs carefully and keep human approval in place for employment, financing, M&A, board, and public-communication decisions.
